answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 42254 Country: Pakistan Title: Plates/glasses/pans used in non-muslim country Question: Pans used for cooking food and knife/fork used to eat pork is presented to a Muslim for eating fish, though it is washed and cleaned. Is taking food from in such hotels halal? Answer ID: 42254 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2234/1738/B=1433) If those pans, knives and forks are washed thrice and are cleaned then a Muslim can use it to eat fish. It is better that a Muslim washes it with his own hands thrice and then use the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
